# Final report: real10

71 views: 0 polished, 71 Cycles (gate_validation 6, not_run 65). Stages: render run, gate validation not_run, polish not_run, vision check single_pass (calibration run). A polished image is final only when the gate accepted it and the vision check checked it without finding a lost or added element (§5.5). Mismatches are listed with their evidence and never auto-fixed.
